communityPosts.author: Sukhwinder Singh
communityPosts.title: Yellow stripe observed on early wheat nursery - how to verify?
communityPosts.content: Saw faint yellowish lines on leaf tips this morning. Is it stripe rust or just zinc deficiency due to cold water?
communityPosts.verifiedAnswer: Rub the leaf with a white tissue paper. If a powdery yellow stain comes off on the paper, it is Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis). Spray Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1ml/L immediately.

communityPosts.author: Dr. Ananya Patil
communityPosts.title: Advisory: High humidity alert for Tomato & Chilli growers in Western region
communityPosts.content: Due to prevailing dew formation and cloudy weather, early blight and powdery mildew risk is critical. Ensure staking and spray Bacillus subtilis or Mancozeb as prophylactic.
